about: Austria's A 10 summer bans for trucks over 7.5 t (and truck-trailer combinations over 7.5 t together) in 2026, transcribed from the consolidated text in RIS; tools/tables/check_bans.py checks the dates and hours against it. Each ban holds only on the roads, directions or destinations its note names, so a trip is said to may run into it.
